summary: Expanded isExplorationTask in daemon.js (~line 2980) to also treat note-kind tasks and supersede-edge source tasks as exploration, in addition to orch/attempt/ branches. Added supersededIds set derived from T.ov.edges filtered by kind==='supersede'.

subject: Expand isExplorationTask — note nodes and supersede-edge tasks
description:
In daemon.js around line 2979-2980, expand the exploration definition to cover the two structural signals:

1. Tasks that appear as `from` in a supersede edge (they were superseded by a replacement)
2. Note nodes (kind==='note') — semantically exploration/knowledge capture, not shipped work

Change from:
```js
      const isExplorationTask = (t) => !!(t.git && t.git.branch && t.git.branch.startsWith('orch/attempt/'));
```

To:
```js
      const supersededIds = new Set((T.ov.edges || []).filter(e => e.kind === 'supersede').map(e => e.from));
      const isExplorationTask = (t) => t.kind === 'note' || supersededIds.has(t.id) || !!(t.git && t.git.branch && t.git.branch.startsWith('orch/attempt/'));
```

T.ov is already in scope (established earlier in the /costflow handler via targetOverlay). T.ov.edges is the raw edge array from the overlay store.
